subject: Whistic vendor portal onboarding and SOC 2 evidence for HelioPay
messages:
From: Kate Liu <kate.liu@whistic.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: sam.reed@heliopay.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Whistic vendor profile invite for HelioPay - initial list of evidence

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for agreeing to onboard Redwood Inference into HelioPay's Whistic vendor portal. I've created the initial invite and listed the items we'll need to complete the profile. Please let me know who on your team will be the primary owner for uploads.

Required items to get to "Questionnaire Complete":
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest period) [upload copy]
- Completed CAIQ (we can pre-fill some answers if you have a canonical doc)
- Network diagram (high level, non-sensitive)
- Contact for security and SOC evidence requests (email + phone)

I've attached the invite link and a short instructions PDF. If you prefer we can accept the SOC report via secure upload to your S3 or via our portal.

[Attachment: Whistic_Invite_Link.txt]
[Attachment: Whistic_instructions.pdf]

Thanks,
Kate Liu
Vendor Onboarding, Whistic
kate.liu@whistic.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kate Liu <kate.liu@whistic.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Whistic vendor profile invite for HelioPay - initial list of evidence

Hi Kate,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll own the profile and coordinate uploads with Dev and Vivek. A few quick clarifying items before we upload:

1) Scope: Does HelioPay need only production controls or also staging/test environment details?
2) SOC report: we'll upload the PDF. Are you able to accept a redacted public version or do you need the full report?
3) Access: please grant view access to marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, and security@redwood.com.

Tentative timeline: we can get the SOC PDF + network diagram uploaded by Tuesday (Mar 2) if that works. Vivek, can you confirm we can generate the access logs export for the last 90 days for the upload?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: Whistic_Invite_Link.txt]
From: Kate Liu <kate.liu@whistic.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: onboarding@whistic.com, Sam Reed <sam.reed@heliopay.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 08:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Whistic vendor profile invite for HelioPay - initial list of evidence

Marissa,

Thanks — scope note: HelioPay requests production controls; test/staging evidence is optional but helpful if it differs materially.

We can accept a redacted SOC 2 Type II as long as the control descriptions and auditor opinion are intact. Please also include the control mapping (if you have a one-page mapping to SIG/CAIQ).

I've granted view permissions to the three emails you listed. Uploads can be made directly in the portal or via our secure upload link. If you upload to the portal, set visibility to "HelioPay: security@heliopay.com" and "Whistic support".

For timeline, Mar 2 is fine. If you need more time, let me know — we can set a 2-week cushion.

[Attachment: Whistic_instructions.pdf]

—Kate
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Liu <kate.liu@whistic.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 11:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Whistic vendor profile invite for HelioPay - audit logs and retention

Marissa / Kate,

We can provide the access logs export for the last 90 days; attaching a scrubbed export to this thread for HelioPay review. A few notes:
- We redact internal IP ranges and any user identifiers per our data policy. The export includes timestamps, request path, and anonymized user ids.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit (we also support TLS 1.3).
- Retention: Default production logs retained 180 days; longer retention available under Dedicated contracts.

[Attachment: access_logs_export.csv]

Kate — does HelioPay need a signed statement on retention policy or is the CSV sufficient for now?

Thanks,
Vivek
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kate Liu <kate.liu@whistic.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Reed <sam.reed@heliopay.com>, onboarding@whistic.com
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic vendor profile invite for HelioPay - audit logs and retention

Vivek — this is perfect, thank you. HelioPay's security team will want the SOC2 PDF + network diagram in addition to this export. For the retention statement, a short signed letter (one paragraph) on your letterhead is preferred but not required immediately.

Next steps for Redwood:
- Upload SOC2_Type2_Report_2025.pdf to the Whistic portal and set view to HelioPay.
- Upload network-diagram.png (high level).
- Upload the access_logs_export.csv (redacted) — looks good.

Sam, I'll mark the Whistic questionnaire as "Evidence uploaded, pending review" once those items are in.

Best,
Kate
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, legal_team <legal@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Liu <kate.liu@whistic.com>, Sam Reed <sam.reed@heliopay.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Whistic vendor profile onboarding - HelioPay (profile ready for review)

Team —

We completed the uploads to Whistic this morning: SOC2_Type2_Report_2025.pdf, network-diagram.png, and the redacted access_logs_export.csv. Kate confirmed visibility settings.

Action items before I mark profile complete:
- Legal: please review the brief retention statement Vivek drafted and confirm it's acceptable to share with HelioPay (I copied legal@redwood.com).
- Dev: Dev, can you confirm the redaction process used (IP ranges) so I can note it in the portal comments?
- Vivek: please retain the raw export for audit timelines in case HelioPay requests full logs under NDA.

I'll mark the Whistic questionnaire "Evidence uploaded, pending review" after Legal confirms. Kate, can you ping Sam to confirm an expected review window?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
